title: Write your prompt to specific frame/timecodes (e.g., “1s static hold before the…
content: Write your prompt to specific frame/timecodes (e.g., “1s static hold before the kiss,” “start transformation bloom at [timecode],” “whip pan on the beat”) instead of describing the overall vibe to get Seedance 2.0 to hit exact timing cues.
tips: Write your prompt to specific frame/timecodes (e.g., “1s static hold before the kiss,” “start transformation bloom at [timecode],” “whip pan on the beat”) instead of describing the overall vibe to get Seedance 2.0 to hit exact timing cues.

es.content: Escribe tu prompt con fotogramas/timecodes específicos (por ejemplo, “1s static hold before the kiss”, “start transformation bloom at [timecode]”, “whip pan on the beat”) en lugar de describir la vibra general para lograr que Seedance 2.0 acierte las señales de timing exactas.

fr.content: Rédigez votre prompt en précisant des frames/timecodes spécifiques (par exemple : « maintien statique de 1 s avant le baiser », « lancer l’éclosion de la transformation à [timecode] », « whip pan sur le beat ») au lieu de décrire l’ambiance générale, afin d’obtenir de Seedance 2.0 qu’il respecte des repères temporels précis.

ja.content: Seedance 2.0 に正確なタイミングの合図を合わせさせるには、全体的な雰囲気を説明するのではなく、特定のフレーム／タイムコードに基づいて prompt を書いてください（例: “1s static hold before the kiss,” “start transformation bloom at [timecode],” “whip pan on the beat”）。

ko.content: Seedance 2.0가 정확한 타이밍 신호를 맞추도록 하려면, 전체적인 분위기를 설명하기보다 특정 프레임/타임코드에 맞춰 prompt를 작성하세요. 예: “키스 직전 1초간 정지 홀드,” “\[timecode]에서 변신 bloom 시작,” “비트에 맞춰 whip pan”

pt.content: Escreva seu prompt com quadros/timecodes específicos (por exemplo, “1s static hold before the kiss”, “start transformation bloom at [timecode]”, “whip pan on the beat”) em vez de descrever a vibe geral, para fazer o Seedance 2.0 acertar os cues de timing exatos.

zh.content: 将你的 prompt 具体到帧/时间码（例如：“1s static hold before the kiss”、“start transformation bloom at [timecode]”、“whip pan on the beat”），而不是只描述整体氛围，这样可以让 Seedance 2.0 精准命中时间点提示。
